name: NimbaSMS

open_questions: NimbaSMS's pages (https://www.nimbasms.com, /conditions-generales-d-utilisation, /nos-tarifs, https://developers.nimbasms.com) do not say whether an individual without a registered business can open an account, nor which documents are required to open it or to have a sender name validated.

description: NimbaSMS is a Guinean professional messaging platform supporting SMS, WhatsApp, and email delivery from a single API with contact and group management.
example_prompt: Add SMS verification to my app using NimbaSMS.
